scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/domain.test.mjs tests/search.test.mjs tests/import-calendar.test.mjs tests/calendar-sync.test.mjs tests/calendar-feed.test.mjs tests/repeat.test.mjs tests/client-network.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: node tests/lab-isolation.integration.mjs && node tests/calendar-import.integration.mjs && node tests/calendar-feed.integration.mjs && node tests/membership.integration.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.cf:d1:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply lab-of-time-db --remote --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.cf:d1:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply lab-of-time-db-staging --remote --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.cf:d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply lab-of-time-db --local --config dist/server/wrangler.json --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.cf:deploy: node -e 'if(!process.env.CLOUDFLARE_D1_ID){console.error("CLOUDFLARE_D1_ID is required for production deployment.");process.exit(1)}' && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
